description: Item detail (FAM-20): PullItemDetail with CompareArmor and CompareWeapons: the detail text, the compare blocks and the reference list rows of ~150 stratified stock items.
notes: Each `rows` step seeks every key in tabItems and runs PullItemDetail(txtDetail, recording ListView, attack kind, full details); outputs '<as>' (the list rows [Text, Tag, cells]) and '<as>.capture' (per key: detail = the text box, events = the ListView sort requests and handled errors of that call).
ListView sorting is a skipped feature: SortListView, LV_RefreshSort and LV_RefreshSort_ShopsFirst are recorders (events sort_listview and lv_refresh_sort).

Characters are the pipeline scenario's ladder warrior and mage with a weapon, rings and wrists added to the gear; RefreshAll runs once per case. Compare cases set nEquippedItem with the global filter off.
GetLairInfo answers from data.lairs (invented numbers on real group indexes), as in the locations family.
data holds the records the cases can reach (items, every spell, class, race and monster name, shops, rooms, textblocks).
